attributes.board_name: Pennsylvania State Board of Examiners in Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved continuing education programs (49 Pa. Code §45.505). Up to 10 clock hours per biennium may be granted case by case for lecturing/speaking or publishing (request with fee at least 180 days before the period ends); instructors of approved programs get attendee credit. No credit for the same program twice in one cycle.
rules.audit_note: Licensees certify CE completion on the renewal; random audit of renewals, audited licensees submit certified CE records. Keep records at least 4 years. Child abuse CE must be electronically reported by the approved provider before the license can renew.

topics.who: All licensees; Department of Human Services/Bureau-approved course, counts toward the 20 hours; one course credits both licenses for dual licensees
Applicants for an initial license (licensure requirement, not part of renewal hours)

rules.notes: 20 clock hours per license per biennium, so a dual SLP and audiology licensee needs 20 for each license. Licenses expire July 31 of every even-numbered year. Pennsylvania does not license SLP assistants.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Each speech-language pathologist or audiologist shall have completed 20 clock hours of continuing education per license during each preceding biennial period,…
